Because the identifier is a deterministic hash of that normalized 28 * identity, every owner in a household maps to the same value automatically, 29 * independently and across requests, without any owner having to opt in. 30 */ 31 @Component 32 public class HouseholdIdGenerator { 33 34 private static final int ID_LENGTH = 12; 35 36 /** 37 * Build the shared household identifier for the household identified by the given 38 * last name and postcode: the first {@value #ID_LENGTH} hex characters of the 39 * SHA-256 digest of {@code normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode}. 40 * 41 *

An owner without a postcode belongs to no shared household, so this returns 42 * {@code null} in that case. 43 * 44 * @param lastName the household's last name 45 * @param postcode the household's postcode 46 * @return the stable household identifier, e.g. {@code "0a1b2c3d4e5f"}, or 47 * {@code null} when no postcode is supplied 48 */ 49 public String generate(String lastName, String postcode) { 50 if (postcode == null || postcode.isBlank()) { 51 return null; 52 } 53 String identity = normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode; 54 return Sha256.hex(identity).substring(0, ID_LENGTH); 55 } 56 57 /** 58 * Normalize the last name for comparison: trim, collapse each run of whitespace to 59 * a single space and lower-case, so that differences in case or spacing do not 60 * split what is really one household. 61 */ 62 private static String normalize(String value) { 63 if (value == null) { 64 return ""; 65 } 66 return value.strip().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); 67 } 68 } 69

- File: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- Method: `Owner.getIdentityKey()` (a `@Transient` derived getter), lines 449-455:

```java
@Transient
public String getIdentityKey() {
    String telephonePart = this.telephone == null ? "" : this.telephone;
    String emailPart = this.email == null ? "" : this.email;
    String householdPart = this.householdId == null ? "" : this.householdId;
    return telephonePart + "|" + emailPart + "|" + householdPart;
}
```

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — shared black-box harness (POST `/api/owners`, GET `/api/owners/{id}`). Payload builders `structuredOwner()` (lines 136-142), `uniqueEmail()` (106-108); `deleteOwner` helper (lines 195-197) documents soft-delete/ignored-by-duplicate-checks; includes a `sha256hex` helper (lines 282-294).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` — audit-log capture support (matched keyword only via license header; not duplicate-specific).

### Bottom line
The production identity/duplicate logic is **household-based and soft**: `identityKey` = plaintext `telephone|email|householdId`, `householdId` = 12-hex SHA-256 of `lastName|postcode`, and a duplicate is only *flagged* (`possibleDuplicate`), never rejected. If the task is to make the tests pass, `Owner.getIdentityKey()` and the create path in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` are the two places that need to change (plus a new soundex helper).

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it is combined with the last name to form the owner's
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional flat form kept for
            backward compatibility: an owner may instead supply the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields. When structured fields are
            present they take precedence and this value is returned as the
            composed, normalized address; otherwise the supplied flat address
            is used. An owner must supply an address in either form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' and, once
            normalized, becomes the first segment of the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended, after
            a single space, to the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized to E.164 form:
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the
            result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the region derived from the owner's city (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered with the clinic. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand' relative to their registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When true, the create endpoint
            skips the duplicate-household check that otherwise rejects a new
            owner sharing another owner's last name and postcode, and the owner
            is created as a declared household member (not a suspected duplicate).
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title and last name
                separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when
                no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-FRA-0001'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The customer code's check digit: a single Luhn check digit (0-9)
                computed over the digits of the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the owner's normalized last name and postcode. Owners
                with the same last name and postcode share it automatically; absent
                when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '0a1b2c3d4e5f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's
                first and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's fiscal
                year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's business-day-adjusted registration
                date falls in, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year's starting calendar year. The fiscal year
                starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to
                that calendar year's fiscal year and an earlier one to the previous.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at zero: two points for an
                email on file, one more when the owner is unique (namesake count of
                zero), two more for a household of three or more, and three more for
                tenure over one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level

## Summary

I redesigned the owner identity key and duplicate detection to match the spec, keeping each piece of logic in its natural home.

**Identity key (`Owner.getIdentityKey()`)** — now the SHA-256 hex digest of `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)`, replacing the old plaintext `telephone|email|householdId`. It reuses the stored (already E.164-normalized / lower-cased) fields, so it stays consistent with the values duplicate detection compares.

**New shared helpers (model package, alongside `LuhnCheckDigit`/`FiscalYear`):**
- `Soundex.of(...)` — the American Soundex algorithm (single source of truth).
- `Sha256` — moved from `service` (was package-private) to `model` and made public, so both the entity and the existing `HouseholdIdGenerator`/`CustomerCodeGenerator` reuse one hashing implementation instead of duplicating it.
